alex_sales: quick recap — Nora from FinScale wants a short POC using a Dedicated endpoint inside their AWS VPC. Security wants a static egress IP to allowlist, plus answers for the security questionnaire. Can we confirm provisioning steps + ETA and any pricing delta for static egress?

nora_customer: thanks alex. security is worried about IP rotation. they prefer a stable outbound IP for the POC (just for initial allowlist). also: do we need to share keys or can we use some managed creds?

jamie_se: short answers: 1) we can do Dedicated pool with managed egress (we reserve a NAT / static IP) or we can do Private deployment inside their VPC (no outbound egress from our side). For POC most customers pick Dedicated w/ managed static egress — faster.

jamie_se: what we need from customer to provision:
- VPC region (e.g., us-west-2) and preferred AZs
- IP ranges they allow inbound to (if they want to lock down from our side)
- whether they accept our managed NAT IP or want to bring their own NAT/gateway

jamie_se: sample allowlist entry they usually give security: `34.201.23.45/32` (this is the static egress IP we will provide once reserved).

katie_security: two notes for their questionnaire:
- Data flow: we only send inference requests out to the model runtime in the Dedicated pool; we can sign an attestation that no customer files are written to third-party storage for the POC.
- Key handling: for Dedicated we issue API keys scoped to the Dedicated endpoint. If they want, we can accept a short-lived API key rotation cadence (we support key rotation via the Console and via API).

katie_security: also ask them to confirm KMS requirements — do they require a customer-managed key (CMK) for logs/metrics? if yes we need to add it to the onboarding checklist.

raj_infra: provisioning ETA: once we have the region and confirm managed egress, I can reserve the static IP and attach it to the dedicated pool in ~4 business hours (ticket permitting). If they want bring-your-own-NAT, that's dependent on their infra runbook — we only configure routing and SGs on our side.

raj_infra: tradeoffs: managed static egress = faster to stand up, but IP rotation for long-term isn't visible to them unless we schedule a rotation window. BYO-NAT = they retain full control of egress IPs but adds >1 day coordination.

nora_customer: if you reserve the static IP, what happens on rotation? do calls fail for a minute? security team wants guaranteed SLO for the POC window.

jamie_se: rotation is avoidable for a short POC. if we do need to rotate (rare), we do canary the swap: update new IP, keep old IP for 1 hour while routing transitions. downtime is typically <1 minute for active connections but depend on their firewall TTLs. we can include a canary plan in the onboarding doc.

alex_sales: pricing note (ballpark): Dedicated endpoint + static egress add-on is an incremental charge on top of the reserved commit. For a small POC we usually do a 1-week trial on existing credits or a short term PSC — I'll follow up with a formal quote.

nora_customer: also their security questionnaire asks for network diagrams and an example ingress rule. can you paste a minimal example?

jamie_se: minimal inbound rule we ask them to create if they lock to our egress:
```
# On customer's firewall allow inbound traffic from Redwood managed IPs to their internal test endpoint (if using webhook callbacks)
Allow TCP 443 from 34.201.23.45/32 -> internal-loadbalancer:443
```
If they won't accept a managed IP we can use a webhook verification token instead of IP-based restrictions.

katie_security: add to questionnaire reply: logging & retention (we retain request logs for 30 days by default for POC; can extend), TLS 1.2+, mutual TLS if they require it (we can support mTLS for Private deployments).

deploy-bot: created ticket REDWOOD-POC-4827 for "reserve static egress IP & create dedicated pool for FinScale" and assigned to @raj_infra. ETA field: 4h.

alex_sales: action items: 1) Nora share region + whether BYO-NAT 2) Nora send security questionnaire unanswered items by EOD 3) I will put together a short quote for Dedicated + static egress add-on 4) @raj_infra will reserve IP once we confirm region.

nora_customer: sending region now: us-east-1. we'll use your managed egress for the POC. Qs on keys: we prefer short-lived keys.

jamie_se: perfect — we'll issue a scoped API key for the Dedicated endpoint with a 30-day TTL and show them rotation steps. I'll DM docs link: https://redwood.ai/docs/dedicated-egress (internal)

katie_security: I'll draft the questionnaire responses for the network/privacy sections and drop into the shared doc. :thumbsup:

alex_sales: thanks all, i'll update the customer after raj confirms the reserved IP.

raj_infra: reserving now, will post the IP once done.

deploy-bot: ticket REDWOOD-POC-4827 status -> in-progress.
